name: Ecommerce manager
summary: Runs the shop side of an online store: catalogue structure, filters, bundles and order value. Makes it easy for shoppers to find and add more to the basket.

changelog.note: Growth and trading plans now reconcile task hours against each owner's source-period capacity with the existing calculator, preserve dated stock and cash dependencies, and separate planned outcomes from measured results.

First release: category trees, attributes, filters and variants; Google and Meta feed data rules; sell-through and markdown planning; bundles and delivery thresholds; digital products; EU 30-day prior price (Aldi Süd), UK DMCC drip pricing, fake urgency and fake reviews, and FTC price and review rules, with 30 checked sources.
